THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY,
 THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:12390  MFA No. 25552 of 2011  JUDGMENT
This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 17.04.2010, passed by the tribunal, in MVC No.10/2005, seeking for enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.
i. Fracture of Bicondylor upper end of the right tibia ii. CLW 2cmsX1/2 cm on plantar aspect of left grade toe iii.
Grievous injuries.

The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
Sl. Heads. Amount in No. (Rs.)
1. Towards pain and suffering.
30,000-00 2. Loss of income during laid of 15,000-00  period
3. Food and nourishment attendance 15,000-00  and conveyance 4. Loss of future income due to 1,08,000-00  disability 35%X1/3

sentences.text: The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered 35% of physical disability towards right lower limb.
The tribunal has taken 20% as functional disability towards whole body and the same is found to be correct.
7. The claimant is practicing advocate and agriculturist.
The fractured injury certainly causes some effect on working capacity while working as an advocate.
The accident is caused in the year 2003.
In the absence of proof of income, notional income of Rs.3,250/- per month is taken into consideration, which NC: 2023:KHC-D:12390 is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 36 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 15.

Hence, loss of future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.3,250X20/100X15X12=1,17,000-00.
8.

Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.30,000-00 towards pain and suffering,
Rs.30,000- 00 towards loss of amenities are awarded.

The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.21,000-00 is as per the actual bills and receipts produced;
therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.15,000-00 towards incidental expenses like food,
nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.15,000-00 towards loss of income during laid up period, is awarded.

9. Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
NC: 2023:KHC-D:12390 Sl. Heads.

Amount in No. (Rs.)
1. Towards injuries, pain and 30,000-00 suffering.
2. Towards medical expenses.
21,000-00 3. Towards loss of amenities.
Towards loss of income during 15,000-00 laid up period and medical treatment period.

5. Towards incidental charges like 15,000-00 attendant charges, food, nourishment,
conveyance, etc.,.
6. Towards loss of future earning 1,17,000-00 capacity.
 Total: 2,28,000-00 10.
Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total Basavaraj Ramappa Hadimani vs The Managing Director on 12 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14568444/

The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

11. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.

NC: 2023:KHC-D:12390 ii) The judgment and award dated 17.04.2010, passed by the Sessions Judge, Fast Track Court,
Ranebennur, in MVC No.10/2005 stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.2,28,000-00 along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 494 days in filing the appeal.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:12390 vii) No order as to costs.
viii) Draw award accordingly.
